name: 911 Baked Beans Wild Ride
description: Consolidates a folder of filled NC-calc spreadsheets (the 'NC style baked beans' DSTV/linear-inch pricing sheets) into one review list: DYPN, Batch, Nest, Total Bevels, Total Complex Bevels, and Total Cut Lin per part, sorted batch/nest/part with a grand-total row. Prompts only for the folder (the one holding the NC files) - batch + nest are read from each sheet's Batch/Nest cell and name the output, saved into that same folder. Running the Baked Beans spreadsheet itself is a future stop on the ride.
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Fill out the 'NC style baked beans' calc workbooks first - one .xlsm per part, filled from the Vacam NC files.
Open and save each calc sheet in Excel at least once so its totals calculate; un-calculated sheets get flagged instead of read as zero.
Put all the calc workbooks in one folder - that folder is also where the result is saved.
how_it_works: Pick the folder of filled calc sheets.
The app reads each sheet's totals (bevels, complex bevels, cut linear inches) and the batch, nest, and part from the sheet.
It consolidates everything into one review list, sorted by batch, nest, and part, with a live totals row.
output: A '{batch} {nest} NC Baked Beans.xlsx' review list in that same folder, with any un-calculated sheets flagged in the Notes column.
